name: Redis Server Exposed on the Network
description: A Redis server is reachable over the network. Redis has no authentication by default; if it is not bound to localhost or protected by a strong 'requirepass', anyone who can reach the port can read/write all data and may achieve code execution.
remediation: Bind Redis to 127.0.0.1 or a private interface, enable 'requirepass' with a strong secret, enable protected-mode, and firewall the port.
